stories.title: Microsoft has a new machine learning tool to improve weather forecasts
stories.summary: Old-school physics-based weather forecasting and even new AI models typically become less reliable beyond two weeks, a problem Microsoft claims to have solved using machine learning.Researchers with the company say they’ve found a new, cost-effective way to make more accurate weather forecasts two to six weeks in advance — allowing farmers and emergency responders to plan ahead with greater certainty. The findings were published today in the journal Nature, and the tool is now open-source software.Microsoft joins Google, Nvidia, and other companies developing AI tools for weather forecasting. Instead of creating a new standalone weather model, Microsoft’s latest research in this realm uses machine learning to correct bias in existing models.

stories.title: NASA’s Chandra Breaks Down ‘Treble Clef’s’ Galaxy Cluster Collision
stories.summary: Astronomers have used NASA’s Chandra X-ray Observatory to break down the cause of a remarkable formation of radio waves they have nicknamed the “Treble Clef” because its distinct shape strongly resembles the musical symbol. The researchers discovered the Treble Clef is likely caused by an outburst from a supermassive black hole, followed by a collision of two galaxy clusters. A paper describing the findings, led by Andrea Botteon of the National Institute for Astrophysics, or INAF, in Italy, published Wednesday in the Astronomy & Astrophysics journal.

stories.title: 'It's rough out here': Americans struggle with rising inflation
stories.summary: Image source, Kathryn VaughnImage caption, Kathryn Vaughn works many odd jobs to supplement her teacher's salaryByAna FaguyKathryn Vaughn returned to work at a rural West Tennessee elementary school this autumn with a lot more stress on her plate than in previous years.The 46-year-old, like many Americans, is juggling how to provide for her family with rising costs of, as she described it, "everything". She spends her days working three different jobs to support her family of four, including as a primary school art teacher, as US inflation continues to rise.
stories.displayTitle: 'It's rough out here': Americans struggle with rising inflation
stories.originalSummary: US inflation continues to rise, and this month the jump was above forecasts. Here's how some are surviving.
stories.dateEvidence: Inflation in September was above forecasts.Over the past 12 months, prices rose by 3.7% - up from 3.4% in the 12 months to August, according to officials numbers released on Wednesday.High energy prices have driven up the cost of living in America as diesel prices have hit record highs and the price of gasoline has risen too, and all of this has landed on the shoulders of everyday Americans.Once school finishes, Vaughn heads to her second job as a facilitator at an after-school programme for at-risk youth.

stories.title: NASA’s Record-Setting Perseverance Rover Team
stories.summary: 1 Min Read PIA26813 Credits: NASA/JPL-Caltech 10/13/2026 Members of NASA’s Perseverance Mars mission team gather in the Mars Yard at the agency’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Southern California with a certificate from Guinness World Records marking the rover distance record on the Red Planet. Positioned in front of the team is OPTIMISM (Operational Perseverance Twin for Integration of Mechanisms and Instruments Sent to Mars), a full-scale engineering model used to plan the rover’s driving routes and science activities on Mars. NASA JPL, which is managed by Caltech, built and manages operations of the Perseverance rover on behalf of the agency’s Science Mission Directorate in Washington, as part of NASA’s Mars Exploration Program portfolio.

stories.title: Cornell bans all fraternity parties over gang sex assault allegations

stories.title: Perseverance Navcam Image Marks Record Drive
stories.summary: 1 Min Read PIA26812 Credits: NASA/JPL-Caltech 10/13/2026 Rover tracks and a rocky Martian landscape are shown in this image captured by one of the navigation cameras (navcams) aboard NASA’s Perseverance Mars rover on Oct. 11, 2026, the 2,006th Martian day, or sol, of the mission. During that sol’s drive, spanning 299.6 feet (91.31 meters), the mission passed a major milestone: pushing Perseverance’s total driving distance beyond that of the agency’s Opportunity rover, which logged 28.06 miles (45.16 kilometers) during its 15-year mission on Mars.
